```{python}
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import os
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from skimpy import skim
from ydata_profiling import ProfileReport

load_dotenv()
```

```{python}
data_dir = Path(os.environ["DATA_DIR"])
csv_path = data_dir / "data_centers" / "im3_open_source_data_center_atlas" / "im3_open_source_data_center_atlas.csv"
```

```{python}
df_raw = pd.read_csv(
    csv_path,
    dtype = {
        "id":str,
        "state_id": str,
        "county_id": str})
```

### Data Transformations
- concatonate state_id and county_id to form county_id_tmp column
- Drop state, state_abb, state_id, county, county_id, ref columns
- rename id to data_center_id
- rename county_id_tmp to just county_id
- remove leading or trailing spaces in all columns
- Roll up VA independent cities into parent counties

```{python}
df_raw["county_id_tmp"] = df_raw["state_id"] + df_raw["county_id"]
```


```{python}
df_final = df_raw.drop(columns=["state", "state_abb", "state_id", "county", "county_id", "ref"])
```


```{python}
df_final = df_final.rename(columns={
    "id": "data_center_id",
    "county_id_tmp": "county_id"
})
```

```{python}

def roll_up_va_cities_to_county(df):
    df["county_id"] = df["county_id"].replace(city_to_parent_county)
    return df

df_final = roll_up_va_cities_to_county(df_final)
```
